sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MODELS MAINTAIN A PROGRESSIVE FLOW REGIME ACROSS THE CONTINENTAL U.S. THIS FORECAST PERIOD. THE ERN STATES UPPER TROUGH WILL WEAKEN AS IT DRIFTS EWD. MEANWHILE...A STRONGER NRN STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL MOVE FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION...WITH THE NEXT UPSTREAM THROUGH TRACKING INTO THE NWRN STATES AND NRN ROCKIES. A LOWER-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...NOW MOVING THROUGH THE FOUR CORNERS REGION PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY... WILL DEAMPLIFY AS IT CONTINUES EWD THEN SEWD THROUGH THE SRN PLAINS TO THE NWRN GULF COAST REGION. AT THE SURFACE...A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE THROUGH THE GREAT LAKES AND MID MS TO OH VALLEYS WITH THE TRAILING PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY ADVANCING SWD INTO THE SRN PLAINS AND LOWER MS VALLEY REGION. A WARM FRONT WILL LIFT NWD THROUGH ERN TX AND THE LOWER MS VALLEY.

sections.title: SERN OK/CENTRAL AND ERN TX/AR/LA/MS
sections.text: RICH GULF MOISTURE RETURN /SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 70S/ WILL BE UNDERWAY PRIOR TO THE START OF DAY 1...WITH THIS MOISTENING/ ADVECTION PERSISTING ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR/MUCH OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA TODAY. MEANWHILE...MIDLEVEL WINDS ACROSS CENTRAL/ERN TX INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY WLY AS THE INFLUENCE OF THE ERN TROUGH MOVES AWAY FROM THIS REGION. THESE WLY WINDS WILL ADVECT A PLUME OF STEEP LAPSE RATES EWD ATOP THE RETURNING GULF MOISTURE. THESE PROCESSES WILL CONTRIBUTE TO STRONG INSTABILITY... ESPECIALLY FROM CNTRL/ERN TX INTO SRN AR AND LA WITH MLCAPE OF 2500-3000 J/KG...AND POTENTIALLY UP TO 3500 J/KG. AN MCS AND ASSOCIATED MCV WILL LIKELY BE ONGOING AT THE START OF THE FORECAST PERIOD ACROSS PORTIONS OF SRN AND ERN OK AND IN ERN KS/WRN MO. THE EVOLUTION OF THIS FEATURE AND ATTENDANT ONGOING STORMS/CLOUDINESS REMAINS UNCERTAIN FOR THE INFLUENCE IN THE DAY 1 OUTLOOK. ALTHOUGH THE SWLY LLJ IS EXPECTED TO WEAKEN SOME THIS MORNING...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR NEW TSTMS TO DEVELOP ALONG THE SWRN AND SRN EXTENT OF THE MCS IN THE DESTABILIZING WARM SECTOR. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY DEVELOP ALONG THE INTERSECTION OF THE COLD FRONT OR OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES...RETREAT

sections.title: CNTRL THROUGH NRN ROCKIES AREAS
sections.text: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN WHERE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND 40+ KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW SUPERCELLS. INSTABILITY WILL BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED...GENERALLY AOB 500 J/KG...AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO SERVE AS AN OVERALL LIMITING FACTOR FOR A MORE ROBUST SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. NEVERTHELESS...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS MAY ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER STORMS. ..NC/VA TO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES... WIDESPREAD SHOWER AND TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED FROM THE NC AND VA N/NE ACROSS PA AND WRN NY IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE TROUGH AS AN UPPER LEVEL TROUGH CONTINUES TO SLOWLY TRACK ACROSS THE REGION. LAPSE RATES ARE EXPECTED TO BE GENERALLY POOR OVER THE REGION DUE TO LIMITED SURFACE HEATING AND SOME ONGOING CONVECTION. MLCAPE VALUES LESS THAN 1000 J/KG ARE EXPECTED. STRONGER SLY MIDLEVEL FLOW /25-35 KT AT 700 MB/ ASSOCIATED WITH THE ERN U.S. MID/UPPER TROUGH WILL OVERSPREAD MAINLY NRN VA NWD INTO NY. THIS COULD AID IN SOME GUSTY WINDS...THOUGH THE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN FAIRLY ISOLATED. FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS NC AND SRN VA...WEAKER DEEP LAYER FLOW IS EXPECTED... BUT BETTER INSTABILITY /MLCAPE AROUND 1000 J PER KG/...RICHER BOUND

sections.title: SOUTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: A LARGE CLUSTER OF SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS HAS AFFECTED MUCH OF OK AND NORTH TX OVERNIGHT. THIS CONVECTION IS SLOWLY WEAKENING...BUT AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THE SOUTHWEST FLANK OF THE MCS THROUGH THE MORNING. ISOLATED HAIL AND/OR GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY. IT IS UNCERTAIN HOW THIS MORNING CONVECTION WILL AFFECT THE SLIGHT RISK AREA TODAY...BUT IT STILL REMAINS LIKELY THAT PARTS OF CENTRAL TX WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG DESTABILIZATION AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF INTENSE/SEVERE STORMS LATER TODAY. OVERNIGHT MODEL SOLUTIONS SEEM TO SHOW A CONSENSUS THAT STORMS WILL REDEVELOP ALONG A SURFACE BOUNDARY EXTENDING ROUGHLY FROM ADM-MWL-JCT BY LATE AFTERNOON...SPREADING SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2000 J/KG...ALONG WITH SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL STORMS. VERY LARGE HAIL APPEARS TO BE THE MAIN RISK...ALTHOUGH HP SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. AN UPGRADE TO MODERATE RISK MAY BE NEEDED IN LATER OUTLOOKS IF CONCERNS REGARDING THE MORNING CONVECTION ARE REDUCED AND THE A

sections.title: SOUTHERN PLAINS TO LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY
sections.text: THE DECAYING REMNANTS OF AN MCS/TRAILING COLD POOL CONTINUE TO SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF NORTH TX/FAR SOUTHERN OK LATE THIS MORNING. INITIAL SEVERE THREAT THIS AFTERNOON WILL BE IN ASSOCIATION WITH WHAT MAY BE AN UPSCALE DEVELOPING QUASI-LINEAR COMPLEX AND/OR AN MCV ACROSS PARTS OF EAST TX INTO LA AND PERHAPS OTHER PARTS OF THE MID-SOUTH/LOWER MS RIVER VALLEY. THE PRECEDING AIR MASS ACROSS THE CORRIDOR WILL CONTINUE TO STEADILY WARM/DESTABILIZE COINCIDENT WITH AMPLE HEATING AND LOWER TO MIDDLE 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS. ISOLATED BOUTS OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON.

AHEAD OF IT...STRENGTHENING CYCLONIC WESTERLIES WILL OVERSPREAD AREAS AS FAR SOUTH AS THE GREAT BASIN/UT VICINITY. ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS THE NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION INCLUDING PARTS OF EASTERN ORE/WA AND ID/WESTERN MT. sections.title: TX THROUGH LOWER MS VALLEY AREA
sections.text: HAVE ADJUSTED PROBABILITY AND CATEGORICAL GRAPHICS TO ACCOUNT FOR EFFECTS OF AN EXPANSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM CNTRL ARKANSAS SWWD THROUGH NWRN LA THEN WWD THROUGH CNTRL TX TO A THERMAL LOW NEAR JUNCTION. MEANWHILE A COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM SWRN MO THROUGH SRN OK INTO SWRN TX IS ADVANCING SWD. DRYLINE EXTENDS FROM EAST OF SANDERSON NEWD TO THE THERMAL LOW JUST WEST OF JUNCTION. THE ATMOSPHERE IN VCNTY OF AND JUST SOUTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS MUCH OF CNTRL AND SCNTRL TX HAS BECOME VERY UNSTABLE WITH 3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE AND VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES. MEANWHILE...NEAR SFC WINDS REMAIN ELY JUST NORTH OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND SELY IN WARM SECTOR BENEATH MODEST /30-35 KT/ MID LEVEL FLOW RESULTING IN VEERING LOW WIND PROFILES AND 30-35 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. THE MOST LIKELY AREA FOR INITIAL ROBUST THUNDERSTORM INITIATION APPEARS TO BE NEAR JUNCTION WHERE CUMULUS IS INCREASING IN VICINITY OF THE DRYLINE-OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTION. ONCE STORMS INITIATE...THEY WILL LIKELY TAKE ON SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH A THREAT FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES AS THE STORMS MOVE EAST AND INTERACT WITH THE MODIFYING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A FEW TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND THE TORNADO THREAT SHOULD REMAIN IN CENTRAL TEXAS. ADDITIONAL...BUT MORE ISOLATED...STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE...YET THIS EVENING...IN THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL ROCKIES AND THE HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: TX INTO LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A WEAK COLD FRONT WILL SHIFT EWD INTO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES...AND THROUGH THE OH VALLEY AND MID SOUTH THIS FORECAST PERIOD. THE TRAILING PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY EXTENDED WSWWD FROM SERN AR THROUGH FAR NWRN LA TO NEAR KACT AND THEN WWD TO IN VICINITY OF THE TSTM CLUSTER LOCATED BETWEEN KBWD AND KSJT. 00Z SOUNDINGS AT DRT/CRP/LCH AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOWED A RESERVOIR OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 2500 TO NEAR 4000 J PER KG/ EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL/SRN TX INTO LA. NWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS OF 35-40 KT ATOP SOME STRENGTHENING OF SLY WINDS ACROSS SRN INTO CENTRAL TX WILL MAINTAIN STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-50 KT FOR ADDITIONAL ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. GIVEN THESE FACTORS...THE POTENTIAL REMAINS FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO THREAT/DAMAGING WINDS YET THIS EVENING ACROSS MAINLY CENTRAL TX...WITHIN WW 288. MEANWHILE... BOUNDARY INTERACTIONS INCLUDING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED COLD FRONT AND ANOTHER EXISTING BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDED WWD FROM SERN TX TO NEAR 20 N JCT AND SWWD TO 40 NW DRT WILL ALSO BE FOCI FOR NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN THESE FACTORS INCLUDING THE DEGREE OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY...POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR AN MCS TO DEVELOP ACROSS C

sections.title: NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST TO THE CENTRAL ROCKIES
sections.text: RESIDUAL INSTABILITY INTO THE EVENING WILL SUPPORT A FEW ADDITIONAL STORMS PRIOR TO THE ENVIRONMENT STABILIZING. FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS FOR A SMALL PART OF NERN NM...REFER TO MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 977. MEANWHILE...FARTHER NORTHWEST INTO THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST... TSTMS COULD PERSIST THROUGH THE EVENING AND TONIGHT GIVEN HEIGHT FALLS SPREADING ACROSS THIS REGION WITH THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST TROUGH. MARGINAL INSTABILITY SHOULD LIMIT THE COVERAGE OF STRONGER AND ANY SEVERE STORMS. ..PETERS.. 06/13/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE INCREASING IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY PROGRESSING SEWD. PRIMARY THREAT INITIALLY APPEARS TO BE LARGE HAIL GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF A STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A WW...WHICH MAY BECOME MORE PROBABLE INTO THE LATE MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC IMAGERY SHOWS INCREASING CONVECTIVE TRENDS ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ASSOCIATED WITH A DECAYING MCS OVER N TX. THE STRONGEST STORMS AS OF 1345Z WERE LOCATED OVER VAN ZANDT AND KAUFMAN COUNTIES TX. BOTH SHV AND FWD RAOBS SAMPLED AN AIR MASS CONDUCIVE FOR VERY LARGE HAIL PRODUCTION...CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE...YIELDING MUCAPE VALUES OF 2500-4000 J/KG. THE PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR APPEARS TO BE VEERING BUT WEAK DEEP-LAYER FLOW...BUT THIS SHOULD STILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR AT LEAST MARGINAL STORM ORGANIZATION. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THE INITIAL THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE MID-LATE MORNING. HOWEVER...AS DIURNAL HEATING BECOMES MORE SUPPORTIVE FOR SFC-BASED CONVECTION /AS TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE MID-80S F/...THE POTENTIAL FOR DMGG WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO SHOULD INCREASE...WITH THE FORMER THREAT ENHANCED IF CONVECTION CAN EVOLVE INTO SMALL LINE/BOWING SEGMENTS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR INCREASING SVR POTENTIAL THROUGH THE LATE MORNING...WHICH MAY REQUIRE WW ISSUANCE ACROSS EAST/NORTHEAST TX AND NORTHWEST LA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RISK FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL MAY EXIST ACROSS NRN AR/SRN MO AND INTO SRN IL THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THE MAGNITUDE OF THE THREAT WILL LIKELY BE INSUFFICIENT FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BAND OF TSTMS EXTENDING FROM DOUGLAS COUNTY MO SWD INTO BAXTER COUNTY AR /AS OF 1640Z/ HAS SLOWLY INTENSIFIED OVER THE PAST 1-2 HRS...AND IS LIKELY OCCURRING IN ASSOCIATION WITH A MCV OVER SWRN MO. WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER AND INTERMITTENT PRECIPITATION WAS NOTED ACROSS CNTRL/NRN PORTIONS OF MO...WITH AN EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT/OUTFLOW COMPOSITE BOUNDARY POSITIONED ACROSS SERN INTO CNTRL MO. STRONGER HEATING WAS OCCURRING ACROSS SRN/ERN PORTIONS OF MO AND NRN AR WITH TEMPERATURES REACHING THE MID-70S F AS OF 16Z. THIS CORRIDOR WILL CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY DESTABILIZE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 500-1000 J/KG PROBABLE...AND SHOULD SUPPORT STORM SUSTENANCE INTO SERN MO AND FAR SRN IL. AMBIENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK ACROSS THE REGION...BUT ISOLATED INSTANCES OF STRONG WIND GUSTS COULD ACCOMPANY THE TSTM LINE WITH EWD PROGRESSION. THE POTENTIAL FOR HAIL MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS...BUT GIVEN CONVECTIVE MODE CONSIDERATIONS AND MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...THIS THREAT MAY BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED AS WELL. GIVEN THE AFOREMENTIONED LIMITING FACTORS...THE SVR RISK APPEARS TO BE INSUFFICIENT FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION APPEARS TO BE INCREASING ACROSS W-CNTRL AND CNTRL TX. TSTMS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO RAPIDLY BECOME SEVERE...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL...DMGG WIND GUSTS...AND A TORNADO OR TWO. A WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED AS EARLY AS 20-21Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A RATHER COMPLEX SCENARIO IS UNFOLDING ACROSS W-CNTRL/CNTRL TX...OWING TO A DECAYING MCS OVER N/NE TX AND THE RESULTANT STABILIZATION OF THE AIR MASS ACROSS THAT AREA...AND THE PRESENCE OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND A SYNOPTIC FRONT. AS OF 19Z...SUBJECTIVE SFC ANALYSIS PLACED A SFC LOW N OF DEL RIO...ATTENDANT TO A COLD FRONT THAT EXTENDS NWD TO APPROXIMATELY 30 E BGS...AND THEN NEWD TO NEAR THE RED RIVER. MEANWHILE...AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/WIND SHIFT HAS PROGRESSED SWD TO BECOME ORIENTED W-E ROUGHLY FROM JCT TO AUS...WITH MORE SUBSTANTIAL HEATING OCCURRING HERE COMPARED TO AREAS TO THE N WHERE EARLIER CLOUD COVER/PRECIPITATION HAS LIMITED HEATING SOMEWHAT. VERY STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING S OF THIS BOUNDARY...WHERE TEMPERATURES ARE IN THE UPPER 80S TO 90S F. THE COMBINATION OF A HOT/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES IS YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES OF 3000-4000 J/KG. WHILE STILL UNCLEAR...CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS BECOMING MORE PROBABLE ACROSS W-CNTRL TX AS CINH IS QUICKLY ERODING...AND AN UPSTREAM IMPULSE OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS IS APPROACHING THE REGION. GIVEN THE VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS...TSTMS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO QUICKLY BECOME SUPERCELLULAR AND PRODUCE VERY LARGE HAIL...IN ADDITION TO DMGG WIND GUSTS. THE TORNADO THREAT MAY BE LIMITED S OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHERE LARGE T-TD SPREADS EXIST AMIDST STRONG HEATING...BUT RELATIVELY MORE ENHANCED ALONG/N OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IN THE PRESENCE OF RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE AND BACKED SFC WINDS. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR WW ISSUANCE...WHICH MAY OCCUR AS EARLY AS 20-21Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON OVER HIGH TERRAIN OF CENTRAL COLORADO AND NORTHEASTERN NEW MEXICO WITH A THREAT FOR SEVERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A BRIEF TORNADO IS ALSO POSSIBLE WITH STRONGEST SUSTAINED SUPERCELL STORMS. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION IS BEGINNING TO FORM OVER HIGH TERRAIN IN CENTRAL COLORADO AND NORTHEAST NEW MEXICO...WITHIN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE FROM 500-1000 J/KG...AND 35-45 KT 0-6 KM SHEAR. COMBINED WITH LOW LEVEL ESELY FLOW...ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT ISOLATED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WHICH ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE SOUTH SOUTHEASTWARD OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN. HAIL FORECAST GUIDANCE FROM NAM AND RAP FORECASTS SUGGEST MAXIMUM HAIL SIZE BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 INCHES WITH STRONGEST STORMS. DRY SUB CLOUD LAYER WITH STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT. BASED ON LATEST CAM GUIDANCE...INCLUDING 12Z SSEO AND 17Z HRRR...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE MOVING SSEWD WITHIN THIS FAVORABLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT BEFORE COMPLETELY DISSIPATING BY 0600 UTC.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY DEVELOPING TSTMS ACROSS NERN AR...POSSIBLY EXTENDING DOWNSHEAR E OF THE MS RIVER. WHILE A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PERSISTENT BAND OF TSTMS PRECEDING A MCV/IMPULSE MOVING ACROSS THE OZARK PLATEAU HAS SLOWLY DEVELOPED/EXPANDED SWWD INTO N-CNTRL PORTIONS OF AR THIS AFTERNOON. THIS ACTIVITY IS CO-LOCATED WITH A LOW-LEVEL THETA-E AXIS...CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED AT 1000-2000 J/KG. LATEST WDSS-II RADAR-DERIVED MESH ALGORITHM INDICATES HAIL POTENTIAL WITH THESE TSTMS IS SLOWLY INCREASING. ALTHOUGH AMBIENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK...MODERATE MIDLEVEL WLYS OF AROUND 30 KT WILL SUPPORT AT LEAST MARGINAL STORM ORGANIZATION. IT IS UNCLEAR HOW FAR E TSTMS WILL BE ABLE TO MAINTAIN CURRENT INTENSITY GIVEN SLIGHTLY WEAKER INSTABILITY IN PLACE E OF THE MS VALLEY...BUT AT LEAST A NEAR-TERM THREAT FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS SHOULD EXIST. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS APPEARS TO BE INCREASING IN ASSOCIATION WITH SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS CNTRL/NRN UT...AND COULD EXTEND EWD INTO PORTIONS OF SWRN WY AND FAR NWRN CO LATER THIS AFTERNOON. COVERAGE OF THE THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR SUFFICIENT FOR A WW ATTM...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOP SHOWS INCREASING CONVECTIVE TRENDS ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL/NRN UT...AIDED BY AMPLE DIURNAL HEATING AND STRENGTHENING OROGRAPHIC CIRCULATIONS. THIS AREA IS LOCATED ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF ENHANCED MIDLEVEL MOISTURE AND STRONGER WLYS ALOFT...WHICH HAS CONTRIBUTED TO MARGINAL DESTABILIZATION WITH MLCAPE VALUES ESTIMATED AT 200-500 J/KG. MORE ROBUST DESTABILIZATION IS BEING LIMITED BY MEAGER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE. HOWEVER...DEEP INVERTED-V TYPE BOUNDARY LAYER PROFILES ARE IN PLACE...AND ARE SUPPORTIVE FOR STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS. MODERATE VERTICAL WIND PROFILES EXHIBITING GRADUAL VEERING WITH HEIGHT ARE ALSO SUPPORTIVE FOR MARGINAL TSTM ORGANIZATION IF STRONGER UPDRAFTS CAN TAKE ROOT...WITH AN ENHANCED STRONG WIND GUST AND SMALL HAIL THREAT POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS. GIVEN WEAK LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT AND THE MARGINAL THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...A WW DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE IN STRONGER STORMS ACROSS THE REGION FOR ANOTHER SEVERAL HOURS. AN ISOLATED TORNADO MAY ALSO NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION...BUT THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS COULD STILL INCREASE IN UPSCALE GROWING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DUE TO LINGERING MID-LEVEL INHIBITION ASSOCIATED WITH VERY WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR...AND THE LACK OF STRONGER AND MORE FOCUSED LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION...CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT HAS REMAINED LIMITED TO WIDELY SCATTERED DISCRETE STORMS. BUT IN THE PRESENCE OF LARGE MIXED LAYER CAPE /IN EXCESS OF 3000 J PER KG/...AND MARGINALLY SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS...STORMS HAVE BEEN INTENSE...OCCASIONALLY PRODUCING HAIL IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER...AND PROBABLY GENERATING LOCALIZED STRONG SURFACE GUSTS. THE MORE SUSTAINED STORMS...NOW SOUTH OF ABILENE AND JUNCTION...AND MORE RECENT DEVELOPMENT TO THE NORTHWEST OF FORT HOOD...HAVE BEEN SLOWLY PROPAGATING TO THE SOUTH...EMBEDDED WITHIN A LIGHT NORTHWESTERLY MEAN FLOW. HOWEVER...AS UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH COMMENCES ALONG OUTFLOW EMANATING FROM THESE STORMS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...ACTIVITY MAY TEND TO PROPAGATE MORE TO THE SOUTHEAST THAN SOUTH...WITH AT LEAST SOME ACCELERATION IN SPEED. ..KERR.. 06/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL THREAT WILL PROBABLY CONTINUE FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 30-60 MINUTES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC AND WDSS-II MESH DATA SHOW A SUPERCELL OVER ERN MORA COUNTY EXHIBITING A 2-3 INCH DIAMETER HAIL SIGNATURE ON THE EDGE OF VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES SAMPLED BY THE 13/00Z ABQ RAOB. THE DNR RAOB IS MORE CHARACTERISTIC OF THE HIGH PLAINS ENVIRONMENT IN WHICH THE SUPERCELL IS CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH. RELATIVELY MOIST POST-FRONTAL DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 50S ARE LEADING TO MODERATE BUOYANCY /1000-1500 J PER KG MLCAPE/ WITH A STRONGLY VEERING LOW LEVEL WIND PROFILE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS. EXPECTING THE MORA COUNTY SUPERCELL TO CONTINUE SEWD AND EVENTUALLY WEAKEN AS DIURNAL STABILIZATION LESSENS BUOYANCY AND SERVES TO DIMINISH THE INFLUX OF MOISTURE/INSTABILITY INTO THE PARENT UPDRAFT. UNTIL THEN...A LARGE TO VERY LARGE HAIL THREAT AND A LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUST RISK WILL ACCOMPANY THIS STORM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE EVOLUTION OF AN ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM APPEARS POSSIBLE ACROSS SOUTH CENTRAL TEXAS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS COULD IMPACT THE SAN ANTONIO AREA WITH THE RISK FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...HEAVY RAIN AND FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING...BEFORE CONTINUING TO PROPAGATE TO MIDDLE/LOWER TEXAS COASTAL AREAS OVERNIGHT. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN ADDITIONAL WATCH TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WW 288.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INHIBITION FOR BOUNDARY-LAYER BASED PARCELS IS INCREASING WITH THE ONSET OF SURFACE COOLING ACROSS SOUTH CENTRAL TEXAS. THIS PROBABLY WILL RESULT IN CONTINUED WEAKENING TRENDS WITH LINGERING DISCRETE STORM DEVELOPMENT /INCLUDING THE CELL NOW SOUTH OF UVALDE/ DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. HOWEVER...A SIGNIFICANT COLD POOL...ASSOCIATED WITH STORMS ORIGINATING NEAR THE ABILENE AREA...HAS RECENTLY MERGED WITH ACTIVITY THAT INITIATED NORTHWEST OF FORT HOOD...AND FURTHER CONSOLIDATION AND DEEPENING OF COLD POOLS COULD PROVIDE FORCING FOR ADDITIONAL UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH THIS EVENING. THIS MAY REMAIN MOSTLY WEST OF THE AUSTIN AREA...BUT COULD IMPACT SAN ANTONIO AND AREAS TO THE EAST AND SOUTH BY THE 04-06Z TIME FRAME. STRENGTHENING FLOW /TO AROUND 30-40 KT/ ABOVE THE DECOUPLING BOUNDARY LAYER APPEARS POSSIBLE...CONTRIBUTING TO INCREASING INFLOW OF VERY MOIST AIR /CHARACTERIZED BY LOWER TO MID 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS/ WITH LARGE CAPE. BENEATH WEAK TO MODEST NORTHWESTERLY MID/UPPER FLOW...VERTICAL SHEAR MAY CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASING CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION...ACCOMPANIED BY THE RISK FOR STRONG...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..KERR.. 06/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE RISK SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE INCREASINGLY MARGINAL WITHIN A WEAKENING STORM CLUSTER PROGRESSING SEWD AT AROUND 20-25 KT TOWARDS THE MIDDLE TX GULF COAST. AN ADDITIONAL WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY TRENDS OVER THE PAST HALF-HOUR HAVE BEEN ON THE DECREASE WITH DIMINISHING STRATIFORM AREA AS WELL IN LOW-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY. THIS APPEARS TO BE CONSISTENT WITH THE EXPECTED INCREASE IN MLCIN OVERNIGHT AND MORE PRONOUNCED INHIBITION WITH SRN EXTENT AS SAMPLED IN 00Z CRP/BRO RAOBS. STILL...WITH 20 KT LOW-LEVEL SLYS /PER CRP VWP DATA/ AIDING IN THE INFLOW OF RICH MOISTURE /CHARACTERIZED BY MIDDLE 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS/...CONVECTION WILL LIKELY PERSIST THROUGH THE DURATION OF THE WW AND INTO ADJACENT DOWNSTREAM COUNTIES. HOWEVER...OVERALL RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS APPEARS LIMITED AND SHOULD GENERALLY REMAIN ONLY LOCALLY STRONG BENEATH THE MORE ROBUST CELLS. ..GRAMS.. 06/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY SPORADICALLY OCCUR WITH A COUPLE OF STORMS PROGRESSING NEWD FROM THE GREAT FALLS TO HAVRE AREAS THROUGH ABOUT 11Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE OF STORMS OVER SW CASCADE COUNTY HAVE HAD TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...WITH RECENTLY REPORTED HAIL UP TO AN INCH IN DIAMETER PER WFO TFX. ALTHOUGH THIS ACTIVITY IS LIKELY ROOTED IN THE 800-700 MB LAYER WITH WEAK BUOYANCY CHARACTERIZED BY MUCAPE AROUND 500 J/KG...ROBUST SPEED SHEAR PER TFX VWP DATA WITHIN THE CLOUD-BEARING LAYER IS QUITE FAVORABLE FOR HAIL PRODUCTION. MOST OF THIS WILL PROBABLY REMAIN SMALL GIVEN THE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY...BUT SPORADIC 1 INCH HAIL REPORTS MAY CONTINUE TO BE REALIZED FOR A FEW HOURS AS ACTIVITY EVOLVES NEWD WITHIN A CORRIDOR OF FRONTOGENETIC-FORCED ASCENT DOWNSTREAM OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH CENTERED OVER WA.
